decisions.assessment: The newborn wording treats names, care talk, and pauses as ordinary conversation without requiring a visible response or assigning the older sibling a caregiving role.
The fixed-toy description preserves the appendix's alternative age and sitting cue, protects self-initiated sitting, and leaves continued use to present interest.
The new 3–6-month placement keeps signs optional and both source age labels visible while inviting parents to respond to existing sounds and gestures.
Both early placements frame songs as shared listening with optional response, so the reused variations do not imply performance or equipment requirements.
The early placements keep changing as necessary, gentle adult care with optional baby response, without importing later standing or toilet expectations.
